pc_operator_comparison.base_station_PC_mass_basis: T16-09 = 75 kg aggregate; no standalone PC mass. Deltas use catalogue KF125 body + illustrative ABB 0.55 kW motor and omit mounts / VFD.
pc_operator_comparison.disclosure: Tabulated efficiency belongs to its tested pressure and viscosity. It is a comparison, not a validated upper bound on efficiency at the duty point.

pc_options.note: Below 2 bar: pressure extrapolation at 34 cSt. Cold: rounded viscosity correction, see p.20.
Below 5 bar: extrapolated. Oil viscosity interpolated between the 6/68/400 cSt catalogue maps.

The illustrated IEC rating is a budget case only. The 20 cSt curve at 1200 rpm gives the pressure slope; idle power and HLP46 cold torque are unresolved. A speed drive is necessary to reproduce 1200 rpm at 50 Hz.

limits: The normal case assumes a decelerated piston ending without a poppet step at nonzero flow.
The catalogue spool response is typical; neither it nor the cycle gate bounds the shortest actual shutoff edge at loss of power.
RE 20478 p. 4 specifies seat behaviour and the nozzle, without a guaranteed passive closing time.
The initial gas state bounds each local transient. Over a full stroke, the catalogue gas regulator must independently meet the flow and pressure requirement.
